decision_summary.market_read: Bull Maduro regime with improving macro delta (+12.5 weekly) supports continued risk-on positioning, but extreme theme concentration in us_tech_ai (55.5%), oil_gas (55%), and crypto (42%) demands diversification toward lower-weight sectors.

selected.reason_short: Bullish-aligned ETF in lowest-concentration theme at 4% weight
selected.reason_full: QQQ posts PCS 73.5 with rot=6 on a 4-week streak and +3.9% ret_4w_vs_spy, offering the cleanest structural setup among all PCS 68+ non-open candidates: fully bullish-aligned Koncorde (D up, 3D up, W up) with extension_risk=low and zero overextension flags. Global_etf theme sits at only 4% portfolio weight — the lowest concentration of any eligible candidate — making it the only viable diversifier against the extreme us_tech_ai (55.5%), oil_gas (55%), and crypto (42%) overweights dominating the portfolio. While 13w outperformance is modest at +1.2%, the 4-week streak shows building momentum in a risk-on macro regime.
selected.comparative_edge: Selected over AMD (PCS=80.5, rot=7) because AMD carries extension_risk=high with ret_4w_extended + spike_flag (4 pts) and adds to the already-overloaded 55.5% us_tech_ai theme; QQQ's low extension risk and 4% global_etf weight provide categorically better diversification. Also preferred over MU (PCS=77.0, rot=8, streak=8w) because MU's konc_alignment=distribution_warning versus QQQ's fully bullish-aligned setup, and MU adds to the same us_tech_ai overweight.
key_supporting_factors: Bullish-aligned Koncorde across all three timeframes (D up, 3D up, W up) with 3D green at 111.37 confirms structural support.
Global_etf theme at only 4% portfolio weight is the lowest-concentration eligible candidate, critical for diversification.
Extension risk is low with zero overextension flags — cleanest entry among all PCS 70+ non-open candidates.
4-week streak with accelerating momentum shows building institutional conviction in a Bull Maduro macro regime.
key_risks_or_contradictions: Ret_13w_vs_spy of only +1.2% is the weakest 13-week return among PCS 70+ candidates, indicating slower long-term momentum build.
Rot_score of 6 is moderate compared to peers like MU (8) and AMD (7), suggesting less robust rotation dynamics.
Dems=6 is below 10, so daily flow data cannot independently support the signal — weekly metrics must lead conviction.
